currentParagraphText: “All done! You two ready to go?” Minaga asked. “As this is an S-grade clone, we will need to use official teleportation channels.”

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Sure, and let’s head back,” the Sword Saint nodded. While he wouldn’t say he and the King ever got particularly close, he had missed his fellow member on the World Council, and it would be good to reunite with another also in dereliction of his political responsibilities.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Fine, we’ll take you up on the offer,” the Sword Saint answered for both of them as Minaga gladly waved his hand. Instantly, the Sword Saint’s body was entirely mended inside and out, with even his resource pools getting filled up a good deal. The Unique Lifeform couldn’t cure the backlash from their boosting skills, but being a bit weaker shouldn’t be a problem if they were just going to a reunion party.
